body.alert_text:
MCA peak filing period.

MCA documents are intermittently accessible on the Ministry of Corporate Affairs (MCA) website due to peak filing season. We will continuously try to access and update the requests as usual.

In case of repeated failures from MCA, we will update the sections that do not require data from MCA documents and reattempt company filing when MCA is accessible at a later date.

Do you want to continue?
